crossRefs.note: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise…
But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since…
saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’
For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the…
that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

parallels.note: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

translations.web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
translations.bsb: They will flog Him and kill Him, and on the third day He will rise again.”
translations.kjv: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
translations.asv: and they shall scourge and kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
